'''Landing Bay Aurek''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] located in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]], a city on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The ''[[Krayt Fang]]'' (the ship of [[Trex]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] in the employ of [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]) was docked at this bay until it was stolen by a group of adventurers escaping from Teemo's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] thugs and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] loyal to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Herkin]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] with illegal connections to Teemo.
